Thing: The most generic type of item; any entity, object, concept, or being. Also called entity, item, object.
DataType: A basic primitive data type such as a number, text, boolean, or date. Also called primitive type, value type.
Boolean: A logical value that is either true or false. Also called logical value, true/false, yes/no.
Text: A plain string of text or characters. Also called string, characters, textual value.
Number: A numeric value, integer or decimal. Also called numeric value, figure, quantity.
Integer: A whole number with no fractional part. Also called whole number, counting number. Examples: 0, 7, 42.
Float: A number with a fractional (decimal) part. Also called decimal, floating-point number. Examples: 3.14, 0.5.
Date: A calendar date (year, month, day) in ISO 8601 format. Also called calendar date, day. Examples: 2026-06-26.
Quantity: A measurable amount such as distance, time, mass, or weight, expressed as a value with a unit. Also called measure, amount, magnitude. Examples: '3 kg', '5 minutes'.
Distance: A measured length or how far apart two things are, expressed with a unit. Also called length, span, range. Examples: '10 km', '5 miles'.
Duration: A length of time, expressed with a unit. Also called length of time, period, interval. Examples: 'PT2H' (2 hours), '30 minutes'.
Energy: A quantity of energy, expressed with a unit. Also called energy amount. Examples: '500 calories', '20 kWh'.
Mass: A quantity of mass or weight, expressed with a unit. Also called weight. Examples: '3 kg', '4 milligrams'.
URL: A web address (uniform resource locator). Also called web address, link, URI. Examples: https://example.com.
PronounceableText: Text together with a phonetic or pronunciation guide. Also called phonetic text, pronunciation.
CssSelectorType: A CSS selector string used to target HTML elements. Also called CSS selector.
XPathType: An XPath expression string used to address nodes in an XML/HTML document. Also called XPath expression.
